commits_data.title: ecmp: refactor the file_info response
commits_data.message:
ecmp: refactor the file_info response

The dissection of ecmp file_info request and response is hard to
understand although the messages themselves are rather simple.
Statements like

proto_tree_add_item(..._tee, hf_ecmp_..., tvb, offset, 4, ENC_BIG_ENDIAN);
offset+= 3;

look suspicious.

This patch refactors the ecmp file_info response dissection and fixes
some minor issues along the way.

Create an intermediate subtree for all received attributes. Add the total
length of the received attributes to this tree.

Rewrite get_file_attribute() to dissect a single ecmp file_info
attribute. Create a subtree for the attribute.

Fix the counting of the bytes we consumed. Make sure that the correct item
is highlighted in the byte view.

commits_data.title: ecmp: fix dissection of file_info request
commits_data.message:
ecmp: fix dissection of file_info request

Playing with the sample capture from bugzilla bug 10562, dissection of
packet 491 (ecmp file_info request) brought up an expert info about a
malformed packet.

The request contains a list of requested attributes. For each attribute,
only the attribute ID is part of the request. The current code tries to
dissect each attribute, this fails when we only have a list of
attribute IDs...

Add a subtree for the list of IDs (and the length of that list).

While at it, remove some unnecessary variable initializers.
